title: koanophyllon jenssenii
intro: Koanophyllon jenssenii, commonly known as Jenssen's rainforest flower, is a species of plant in the family Asteraceae. It is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. Koanophyllon jenssenii has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in relieving pain and improving overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Koanophyllon jenssenii include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
